summary: Build practical brand strategy, brand equity, and governance skills in 5 days. Learn through audits, frameworks, and workshops. Enquire now.
lede: Brand management is the work of defining a brand’s position and identity, keeping its messaging consistent, and measuring how it performs. For brand, marketing, communications, product marketing, and customer experience professionals, this training offers practical ways to audit a brand, make positioning and portfolio decisions, and build a brand equity scorecard.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to shape, protect, and measure a brand across channels, teams, and business priorities.
audience: Business Development Managers using brand credibility
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of marketing, communications, product positioning, or corporate branding. No coding is required. Familiarity with basic customer segmentation, campaign planning, and simple performance reporting will help you move faster, while prior exposure to brand audits, messaging guidelines, or portfolio reviews is useful but not mandatory.
